description: Edition changed deliberately on 2026-09-25 at the user's request: trunk and limb sites now stage on the UICC TNM 9th edition (UICC recommends it from 1 January 2026; T, N, M and the stage groups are those of the 8th), so "UICC 8th edition" now reads "UICC 9th edition" in the pTNM heading and the diagnosis line. Regenerated through this test's --update path, and only the edition changed. Phase 67 (11 October 2026), deliberate: at the user's request the Lymph nodes and Distant metastasis sections print only with a recorded input (a node examined, a metastasis recorded) or the new footer option, and pN is left out of the pTNM when no regional node was examined; only those placeholder lines and the pNX token were removed.
report:
Skin, right forearm, excision

Received in formalin is an ellipse of skin measuring 5.0 x 2.8 x 1.2 cm bearing an ulcerated nodule measuring 2.5 cm. A suture marks 12 o'clock, taken as superior. The lesion is 4 mm from the closest skin edge. The deep surface is inked. The ellipse is serially sliced and all embedded in 5 blocks.

(1) Tip A. (2-4) Lesion, cross-sections. (5) Tip B.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Excision
- Tumour site: Right forearm
- Tumour size: 25 mm (greatest dimension)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Squamous cell carcinoma, not otherwise specified
- Histologic grade: G2, moderately differentiated
- Tumour histology:
  The tumour is a moderately differentiated squamous cell carcinoma, invading the reticular dermis to a depth of 4 mm. It is composed of irregular nests of keratinocytes with moderate nuclear pleomorphism and frequent mitoses, keratinisation being limited to scattered keratin pearls and individually keratinised cells.
- Depth of invasion: 4 mm
- Anatomic level: IV (carcinoma invades reticular dermis)
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified

Margins
- Invasive tumour: All margins negative
  - Closest peripheral margin: 4 mm (superior)
  - Deep margin: 3 mm

Pathological stage (UICC 9th edition)
- pTNM: pT2

BWH tumour classification
- BWH class: T2a: 1 high-risk factor
  - High-risk factors: Tumour diameter 2 cm or more

Additional findings
- None identified

SKIN, right forearm, excision
- SQUAMOUS CELL CARCINOMA, moderately differentiated, 25 mm, invading the
  reticular dermis to a depth of 4 mm; completely excised (closest peripheral
  margin 4 mm, superior; deep margin 3 mm); see synoptic report
- pT2 (UICC 9th edition); BWH T2a
